ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) ventral surface with approximately 5% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips and specific focal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark region across the primary fluke body; high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips; one distinct high-contrast annular ring located on the left lobe approximately 35% of the distance from the median notch to the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 110 degrees and a vertical depth reaching the lower third of the fluke's visible vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency peaks and valleys; notable step-like jagged recession on the medial-posterior edge of the right lobe; smoother, rounded serrations on the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve characterized by a convex medial region transitioning into a concave upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters (resembling barnacle scars) densely packed on both the left and right distal tips; a singular O-shaped white ring mark on the central-left lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy white scarring or biological encrustation at both fluke tips; distinct white annular ring scar on the left ventral lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and isolated white ring-shaped mark on the left lobe, approximately one-quarter of the way up from the leading edge.
